description: This file provides a SQLite adapter layer for the notes backend, including connection setup, schema initialization, and low-level database helpers.

classes.name: SQLiteError
classes.description: Base error for SQLite adapter operations.

classes.name: SQLiteNotFoundError
classes.description: Raised when a requested row is not found.

methods.description: Load SQLite configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: None init_schema(conn: sqlite3.Connection)

methods.name: sqlite3.Cursor execute( conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, )

methods.description: Execute a SQL query and fetch one result or None.

methods.name: list[sqlite3.Row] fetchall( conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: Optional[Iterable[Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Execute a SQL query and fetch all results.
